paragraphs.text: The Blue Blanket was a small basin in Sukurvia in southwestern Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

The Blue Blanket was a hollow featuring an ancient well. It was so named for the color of the hollow's stones, especially remarkable being so far from the Blue Mountains . It was a good site to camp in the desert, as the shallow dish kept one's head out of the wind, and it was dry, where no flash flood could overtake travelers. However, the well was connected to the Sunken Sea , and would rarely quiver and then release a strong gush of water, creating a pool a furlong long. The pool would then drain away throughout a single night. However, the Blue Blanket was eventually buried by the sands of Sukurvia , and can no longer be found.
